title: Model ladder correct on tiny and huge hosts
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. 4 GB RAM, no GPU, multi-GPU and 512 GB hosts must all get a sensible ladder with no config. Tests zc_ladder_edges_*.
